job: Fix production account deletion so preserved support requests and reports cannot roll back deletion when foreign keys clear user-owned references.
preserved: Preserve support requests, support replies, reports about deleted accounts, moderation evidence, and their existing user-visible behavior.
Remove account and sessions immediately while allowing asynchronous owned-media cleanup to continue unchanged.
Preserve all v1.2 UI, Ping, Ghost Mode, messaging, moderation, privacy, billing, and unrelated user work.
Keep cruush lowercase in product text.
nonGoals: Do not redesign Settings or change deletion confirmation copy.
Do not change suspended or banned account navigation in this slice.
Do not change the existing retention policy for reports filed by the deleting account.
Do not delete or weaken retained safety and support evidence.
Do not change providers, secrets, environment variables, billing, analytics, email, or deployment configuration.
Do not send announcements or support messages.

requiredEvidence: A real PostgreSQL regression fails before the fix for both signed-in support history and retained report history.
The same regression passes after the fix and proves the account and sessions are removed while support and report rows remain anonymized.
A real PostgreSQL deadlock regression proves account deletion retries a rolled-back transaction instead of returning 500.
All numbered migrations remain listed in replay order and the full migration sequence replays twice on disposable PostgreSQL state.
Focused account-deletion and migration tests pass; the server test suite and production build pass.
Only allowed paths are staged and no secrets are exposed.
origin/main, production runtime SHA, migration completion, API health, and an authenticated disposable-account deletion are verified independently.
Disposable proof data is removed after verification.

externalActions: Push only the verified scoped commit to origin/main.
Deploy only the production API resource after remote main is verified.
Create and remove isolated disposable production proof records; never delete or alter a real user account.
